analysis.reasonEn: Previous 3 trading days maintained a wait-and-see stance. Today, RSI at 57 remains in neutral territory, and MACD histogram worsened from 0.4604 to -0.0658, but the sideways trend persists. Five consecutive daily closes signal the beginning of a Higher Low pattern recovery. The Volatility Index (VIX) remains high at 14.12%. Following the overall market's risk management stance, new buys are halted, and low positions are maintained. The current price of $22.91 is near the swing resistance of $22.96. Consider entering a buy position upon confirmation of RSI exiting oversold territory below 50 and MACD histogram improvement. Consider a sell entry if the swing resistance of $22.96 fails to break and RSI enters overbought territory above 70.
